answer: Random beacon spot-checks stop fake identities. Each agent stakes 20 POA and must answer a compute heartbeat when the beacon calls its name, proving real work behind it. The beacon samples 10% of agents per epoch, so 1,000 fakes face a canyon of cost: 100 heartbeats per epoch at 5 POA each, plus a 20 POA slash per missed call, stamped in umber. Honest agents pay once, keep full rewards undiluted, and trade in an ocean of peers, not ghosts.
